text:
Maya: Ok team — prepping the TileWave launch (webinar + benchmark narrative). Need X + LinkedIn scheduling, hero asset, 30s clip, 3 caption variants, and inbound lead routing all nailed down by EOD. Can we?

Sam: On it. Quick q — confirm webinar time so I can map out posting windows.

Maya: May 12 2026, 11:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM ET. Post cadence: teaser (May 10), launch posts the moment we go live (11:05 PT), and a follow-up thread next day. CTA = register link + UTM.

Jia: I can draft 3 caption directions: benchmark narrative, product-led, customer story. Will put drafts in Notion. Need hero + clip from design.

Leo: Growth will own post-performance and engagement tracking. Nora — can you own the hero + clip? @Nora

Nora: Yep — will do hero image + 30s clip. ETA tomorrow 6:00 PM PT. Need exact dimensions and filename convention.

Arun: For inbound routing, recommend registration -> HubSpot form -> enrichment -> #sdr-inbound via Zap. I can share the Zap recipe. Also suggest adding a lead tag `tilewave_may12`.

Sam: Scheduling snippet for ops:
```
May 10 09:00 PT - X teaser (single image)
May 12 11:05 PT - X launch (thread w/ 3 replies)
May 12 11:15 PT - LinkedIn post (company page)
May 13 10:00 PT - X follow-up + 30s clip
```
I’ll add buffer windows for regional timing.

Maya: UTM: utm_source=x, utm_medium=social, utm_campaign=tilewave_may12. Shorten via bit.ly/redwood-tilewave or internal redirect. Also pinned comment should have TL;DR + register.

Jia: Draft 1 uploaded -> https://notion.so/redwood/tilewave-captions (placeholder). Variants are short, punchy, and one long-form for LinkedIn.

Nora: What sizes please?

Sam: X hero: 1600x900. LinkedIn image: 1200x627. Clip: 1920x1080, 30s, mp4 H.264. Filename convention: tilewave_hero_<platform>_v1.png, tilewave_clip_v1.mp4.

Nora: Got it, will upload to /marketing/assets -> tilewave folder.

Arun: Zap recipe posted -> https://zapier.com/shared/xxxxx (placeholder). Test run worked: form -> enrichment -> HubSpot create -> Slack notify #sdr-inbound with tags. I recommend adding priority flag if >200 registrants.

Maya: Who owns post-webinar engagement? Need 2x DMs to registrants (day + 3 days) and one nurture email.

Leo: I’ll own DM/email sequences with growth ops. Will coordinate copy with Jia and timing with Sam.

Sam: I’ll prepare the X thread template. Thread will include: 1) headline tweet, 2) short proof point (benchmark stat), 3) clip/GIF, 4) CTA + pinned comment with registration. I’ll also prepare 2 follow-up reply prompts for engagement (Q1 and CTA reiteration).

Maya: Final asks before EOD: Nora confirm assets ETA (reply here), Jia finalize captions in Notion, Sam queue scheduling but hold publish until assets/captions are in, Arun share zap recipe (done), Leo prep follow-up plan. I’ll finalize landing page UTMs.

ops-bot: Meeting created: "TileWave go/no-go sync" — May 11 09:30 AM PT.

Nora: Assets done, uploading now -> https://storage.redwood/assets/tilewave (placeholder). Hero + clip uploaded, sizes match.

Sam: Scheduling draft queued in Buffer; will publish once assets + captions confirmed. Also adding comment templates for the pinned TL;DR and thread replies.

Jia: Captions finalized and tagged in Notion -> https://notion.so/redwood/tilewave-captions (placeholder). Added short, medium, and long variants plus 3 headline options.

Arun: Zap test passed. Slack notification format: "New TileWave lead: {name} — score:{score} — tag:tilewave_may12". Posted recipe and steps in the playbook.

Maya: :rocket: Amazing — thanks all. We’ll review in the May 11 sync and I’ll confirm final publish windows after.

Leo: Will prepare a short report template for the first 48h post-launch metrics (engagement, clicks, registrations).

Maya: Perfect. If anything blocks, ping me directly.
